content: {"reasoning":"The payer denied the service as plan noncoverage (PR-204), and the eligibility lapse supports a benefit-level denial rather than a coding, authorization, or documentation defect. Prior authorization was not required, retro authorization and peer-to-peer are unavailable, and a medical-necessity appeal would not cure lack of coverage. With no secondary payer, the remaining amount properly assigned to the patient should be billed.","action":"bill_patient"}
